note: Both sets capture the page's core claims correctly: the 4 m off-axis monolith baseline, the zeroed field amplitude at the singularity, the topological charge definition, the perfect-starlight-rejection condition (unobscured circular aperture, even charges), and the charge/low-order-aberration trade-off. Set B additionally captures the paired trade-off that higher topological charge gives a larger IWA, an important fact on the page that Set A omits entirely. Set B's extra 'topological charge | relationship to IWA | direct' claim is a vague restatement of its own IWA claim, and both sets repeat the same fact twice (once as a VVC attribute, once as a topological-charge relationship), so neither gains much from those pairs. On balance B is better because it covers the full trade-off statement while A drops half of it.
remarks: Both sets state the same fact twice under two entity/attribute framings (VVC sensitivity vs topological-charge relationship; in B also the IWA pair), which inflates claim counts without adding information. The 'inverse'/'direct' relationship claims are generic and would be better expressed as the single conditioned trade-off claims. Set A's omission of the IWA half of the trade-off sentence is the main substantive gap.
